parser:
import re

def parse(lines):
    blocks = []
    skip = []
    sec = 'summary'
    kv = None
    n = len(lines)
    dash = re.compile(r'^\s*-+(\s+-+)*\s*$')
    kvre = re.compile(r'^(?P<key>[A-Za-z][^:]*?):\s+(?P<value>.*?)\s*$')
    prev_blank = True
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        s = lines[i]
        if not s.strip():
            prev_blank = True
            i += 1
            continue
        if i + 1 < n and dash.match(lines[i + 1]):
            starts = [m.start() for m in re.finditer(r'-+', lines[i + 1])]
            ends = starts[1:] + [None]
            names = []
            for a, e in zip(starts, ends):
                names.append((s[a:e] if e else s[a:]).strip())
            b = {'name': sec, 'kind': 'table', 'lines': [i, i + 1], 'records': []}
            j = i + 2
            while j < n and lines[j].strip() and not dash.match(lines[j]):
                r = lines[j]
                rec = {}
                for nm, a, e in zip(names, starts, ends):
                    rec[nm] = (r[a:e] if e else r[a:]).strip()
                b['records'].append(rec)
                b['lines'].append(j)
                j += 1
            blocks.append(b)
            kv = None
            prev_blank = False
            i = j
            continue
        m = kvre.match(s)
        if m:
            if kv is None:
                kv = {'name': sec, 'kind': 'kv', 'lines': [], 'records': [{}]}
                blocks.append(kv)
            kv['records'][0][m.group('key').strip()] = m.group('value')
            kv['lines'].append(i)
        elif prev_blank:
            sec = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '_', s.strip().lower()).strip('_') or 'section'
            kv = None
            skip.append(i)
        else:
            if kv is None:
                kv = {'name': sec, 'kind': 'kv', 'lines': [], 'records': [{}]}
                blocks.append(kv)
            kv['records'][0]['Note'] = s.strip()
            kv['lines'].append(i)
        prev_blank = False
        i += 1
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': skip}
